description: Check the Dead-End Registry before you spend: graded records that a specific attempt does NOT work — a coin, contract, route, counterparty, claim, or strategy — proven by reproducible evidence and graded PASS on the evidence by the desk. Give a subject (mint, address, route descriptor, counterparty, or claim text). The registry search door is PAID ($0.05 USDC via x402 — the connector is a distribution surface, not a second price list, so this tool returns the door's payment challenge rather than free results). A no-match is an explicit EMPTY: absence proves nothing — it means nobody has filed that failure and had it graded, not that the attempt works.

subject.description: Mint, address, route descriptor, counterparty, or claim text to check against the registry.

name: flow_dead_end_check
